## Christmas shortlist

### ✅ Strongest starter pick: smoked salmon, prawns & horseradish cream
**Why it wins:** it feels properly celebratory, is light enough before ham, needs very little cooking, and is naturally easy to keep gluten-free when served without ordinary bread/crackers. Make individual plates with smoked salmon, cooked king prawns, lemon, dill and horseradish crème fraîche; offer gluten-free crispbreads separately.

- Sainsbury’s has a dedicated [Free From hosting guide and gluten-free recipe hub](https://www.sainsburys.co.uk/gol-ui/features/free-from-hosting).  
- For shopping, Sainsbury’s Christmas Food to Order lists **Taste the Difference Scottish Smoked Salmon & King Prawn Terrine, serves 6, £17**—but because the listing text I could access does **not** state gluten-free, check the live allergen panel/pack before using it for a coeliac guest: [view the starters range](https://food-to-order.sainsburys.co.uk/category/starters).

### Two more genuinely festive gluten-free starter ideas
1. **Roast butternut squash with chestnuts, cranberries and blue cheese**  
   A warm, colourful vegetarian starter with unmistakably Christmas flavours. Roast squash wedges, scatter with vacuum-packed chestnuts and dried cranberries, then add blue cheese and thyme. Use gluten-free-certified ingredients where relevant. Sainsbury’s Free From page specifically features a **roasted squash with chestnuts** recipe idea: [Sainsbury’s Free From hosting](https://www.sainsburys.co.uk/gol-ui/features/free-from-hosting).

2. **Smoked salmon and avocado terrines**  
   Line small cups with smoked salmon and fill with avocado, lemon and crème fraîche, then turn out and top with dill. It is make-ahead, elegant, and avoids pastry entirely. For a tested gluten-free version, use this [Good Food smoked salmon & avocado terrines recipe](https://www.bbcgoodfood.com/recipes/collection/gluten-free-christmas-recipes); buy the salmon and dairy ingredients at Sainsbury’s and check the salmon’s label.

**Gluten-free hosting note:** Sainsbury’s says its Free From range is designed for allergy/intolerance diets, but also advises checking individual packaging for dietary information. In practice, use separate utensils/boards, avoid shared butter, and keep gluten-free crackers or bread separate.

---

## How the ham fits the meal

### Straightforward spiral-cut ham plan
This assumes a **fully cooked, spiral-sliced ham**—it needs reheating and glazing rather than raw-meat roasting.

1. **Take it out of the fridge** while the oven heats. Set oven to **135°C / 275°F**.  
2. **Place cut-side down** in a roasting tin. Add a small splash of water, apple juice or orange juice to the base, then cover the whole tin tightly with foil. This matters: spiral cuts dry out more readily.  
3. **Warm gently for 12–15 minutes per lb** (the guide source specifies this at 275°F), until the centre reaches **140°F / 60°C**.  
4. **Make a quick gluten-free glaze:** stir together honey (or maple syrup), wholegrain/Dijon mustard, orange zest and a little orange juice. Check the mustard is gluten-free.  
5. **Uncover for the last 15–20 minutes**, brush glaze over the top and between a few slices, then return to the oven. Brush once or twice more until shiny and sticky.  
6. **Rest 10–15 minutes**, then transfer to a board or platter and serve. Because it is already spiral-cut, guests can lift off portions easily.

A useful reference is [Good Food’s glazed-ham collection](https://www.bbcgoodfood.com/recipes/collection/glazed-ham-recipes), which includes several recipes explicitly tagged gluten-free, including ginger beer & tangerine glazed ham.

**Easy menu flow:**  
*Smoked salmon/prawn starter → glazed spiral ham → roast potatoes, red cabbage, carrots/parsnips and gluten-free stuffing/gravy.* Sainsbury’s currently lists **Free From beef gravy granules at £1.50**, **Free From sage & onion stuffing at £1.70**, and **Paxo Gluten Free Sage & Onion Stuffing at £3** on its Free From page.

---

## Useful M&S dad stocking fillers — all under £20

| Pick | Current price | Why it is useful | Link |
|---|---:|---|---|
| **Solutions for Men – The Gym Edit** | **£16** | A genuinely usable grooming/fitness-themed small gift rather than novelty clutter. | [M&S gifts for him](https://www.marksandspencer.com/l/gifts/gifts-for-him) |
| **M&S 5 Pack Cotton Rich Ribbed Socks** | **£14** | Reliable, practical and easy to give when you do not know someone’s size beyond shoe range. | [M&S gifts for him](https://www.marksandspencer.com/l/gifts/gifts-for-him) |
| **M&S Smart Belt** | **£10** | The most utilitarian option; useful for work or casual outfits. | [M&S gifts under £20](https://www.marksandspencer.com/l/gifts/gifts-under-20) |

---

## ⭐ Best two gift alternatives to compare visually

|  | **Tommy Hilfiger EDT Holiday Set** | **Original Penguin Trio Body Spray Set** |
|---|---|---|
| **Boots price now** | **£33** | **£6** |
| **What it contains** | **100ml Eau de Toilette + 100ml body wash** | A **trio of body sprays** |
| **Best for** | The smarter, more substantial host/dad present | A modest, branded fragrance stocking gift |
| **Why choose it** | It reads as a proper fragrance gift without going into premium-designer prices | Gives a little more polish than a single deodorant/body-spray can |
| **Direct Boots link** | [Tommy Hilfiger search result](https://www.boots.com/sitesearch?searchTerm=tommy%20hilfiger%20eau%20de%20toilette%20holiday%20set%20100ml) | [Boots men’s body-spray gift-set results](https://www.boots.com/sitesearch?searchTerm=mens%20body%20spray%20gift%20set) |

Boots currently also shows the **Lynx Bodyspray + Bodywash + Towel Sunset Fresh & Epic Fresh Gift Set at £20**, if you want a larger body-spray option, though I would choose the Tommy Hilfiger set for one recipient and the Original Penguin trio for modest stocking-fillers.

Prices and availability can move, especially around Christmas, so it is worth rechecking the product page immediately before checkout.

I’m hosting a small Christmas get-together in the UK and would like help pulling together a sensible food-and-gift shortlist. I need three genuinely festive gluten-free starter ideas from Sainsbury’s, plus a straightforward guide to doing a spiral-cut ham so I can see how the meal would work as a whole.

I also need a few modest gifts for the dads coming: three useful rather than gimmicky stocking fillers from M&S, under £20 each, and two men’s gift sets from Boots that include aftershave or body spray as slightly smarter alternatives. Please include current prices and direct product or recipe links. If possible, keep the strongest starter choice and the two best gift options easy for me to return to and compare visually.

R1.reason: Although Sainsbury’s article/range pages were opened, the answer’s three ideas were not supported by three distinct opened Sainsbury’s recipe or product pages with matching visible titles, and one links to BBC Good Food instead.

R2.reason: The answer calls the salmon starter celebratory and presents a menu flow, but it does not explicitly establish a single coherent starter-led festive style and carry that stated style into the ham framing.

R3.reason: No The Kitchn page was visited or cited—the open ham reference was Good Food and the attempted final ham source was The Tasty Bite—while the user only requested a straightforward spiral-cut-ham guide, not The Kitchn specifically.

R4.reason: The response lists three M&S names and under-£20 prices, but only M&S category pages were opened and all attempts to open the named individual product pages failed.

R5.reason: The response gives two claimed Boots sets and prices, but the agent opened only Boots search-results pages and did not open product pages verifying the sets’ contents or prices.

R6.reason: The final tabs include Sainsbury’s hubs/ranges and M&S/Boots search or category pages, but no selected individual Sainsbury’s starter page and no selected individual gift product pages were left open.

R7.reason: The final response is a single combined shortlist covering starter ideas, a ham approach, M&S gifts, and Boots alternatives, with item names, relevant prices, and brief fit notes.
